purpose.summary: A subprogram (file manager) that provides a generic interface for CRUD operations on an indexed ISAM file (ESTCLI.BIN) containing client statistics records. It accepts an operation code ('O','A','C','S','R','N','W','U','D') via LINKAGE SECTION and dispatches to open, close, start, read, read-next, write, rewrite, or delete routines accordingly.

notable_features: LINKAGE SECTION with operacion, registro, fs-clientes parameters — called as a subprogram
ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED with ACCESS IS DYNAMIC and composite RECORD KEY (COD-CLI + NRO-SEC)
FILE STATUS IS FS-ESTCLI propagated back to caller via fs-clientes
EVALUATE on operation code dispatching to multiple file I/O paragraphs
START with KEY IS GREATER for sequential positioning
Tab characters used for indentation (mixed with spaces — visible in source)
Commented-out DISPLAY debug statements in read-next-clientes
verdict.notes: The file uses tab characters for some indentation (visible in the source), which is non-standard for fixed-format COBOL but tolerated by GnuCOBOL. The program is clearly a subprogram component of a larger system (referenced alongside principal.cbl and estclientes.cbl in the build comment). The composite key structure and file-status handling suggest a student or academic project rather than production code.
